verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions with background event triggers and Cloud Scheduler jobs enable autonomous background automations, and Firebase Extensions/Emulator suite support this workflow, but there's no agent-specific orchestration or AI-native automation framework beyond generic serverless functions. missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent scheduling/orchestration features, independent hands-on evidence of autonomous background automations working reliably, and any agent-specific monitoring/observability for such automations.
